messages:
zoe_fin: Customer NovaAtlas reports ~7k fewer embedding rows on Apr 12 invoice vs their dashboard. They attached sample request ids. Can ops/eng reconcile?
tom_cs: I have the ticket and samples: na-req-1203, na-req-1209. Asking for quick triage.
jake_eng: We pushed SDK connector v3.1 to APAC last week. There's a known async-ack edge where partial-batch failures don't write to ledger (ENG-9701). Likely match.
mira_ops: Kicking off a ledger query for the sample IDs and account window.
replay-bot: started replay job replay-2098-embed-apac for 2026-04-11T00:00:00Z -> 2026-04-12T23:59:59Z (eta ~5m).
mira_ops: Query results: sample IDs show 0 ledger rows; reconstructed missing rows for account = 7,012.
jake_eng: Confirmed bug path. Patch ENG-9701-fix ready; will roll back async-ack change and force a replay backfill.
zoe_fin: Estimate dollars? Contract rate = $80 per 1k rows (enterprise).
mira_ops: (7.012k / 1k) * $80 = $561.
elena_finance: I can approve up to $1k for quick credits. Please attach replay artifact and PR link to billing ticket.
replay-bot: replay completed, artifacts: s3://replay-exports/replay-2098-embed-apac.json.
zoe_fin: Created BILL-1160 with $561 credit, attached artifacts and ENG-9701-fix PR. Sending customer note now.
elena_finance: Approved and closing. Please add incident summary to incidents channel.
